units.text: The Class of 2024 is listed from college rosters, because the school published no signing list for that year. The Class of 2026 is complete: the school’s 2025–26 Athletics Recap names all eight. Each college is the one the athlete signed with out of Davidson Day; Levon Jacobs played his freshman season at the University of Charleston in West Virginia. Level labels and conferences were added by the researcher from each college’s NCAA status; Flagler competes in the Peach Belt Conference through 2026–27 and joins the Sunshine State Conference in 2027–28.
